parameters.name: ClusterIds
parameters.description: A list of cluster IDs. The number of array elements N can range from 1 to 100.

parameters.name: ClusterStates
parameters.description: An array of cluster states. The number of array elements N can range from 1 to 100.

parameters.name: ClusterTypes
parameters.description: A list of cluster types. The number of array elements N can range from 1 to 100.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that specifies the position from which to start the query. If you leave this parameter empty, the query starts from the beginning.

parameters.name: PaymentTypes
parameters.description: The billing methods. The number of array elements N can be 1 or 2.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: A list of tags. The number of array elements N can range from 1 to 20.
